text: This S1000D document is a title page for the S1000D Free Open Source Software Interest Group (FOSSIG) publication. It establishes front matter metadata including document identification, issue date (January 9, 2019), responsible organization (khzae.net), security classification, and associated product illustration. This serves as the cover page for FOSSIG technical documentation.

This S1000D document is a reference list of abbreviations for the Free Open Source Software Interest Group (FOSSIG). It defines key acronyms such as FOSSIG and SNS (Standard Numbering System) in a structured definition-list format. The document was issued January 10, 2019, is unverified, and applies universally to all systems.

This document is a table of contents for the FOSSIG publication (issue 000-01, dated 2019-01-09). It provides a structured index of six chapters covering introduction, business rules, and standard numbering system topics, with each chapter entry linked to its corresponding data module code for reference and navigation within the complete documentation set.

This is an S1000D Business Rules Exchange (BREX) document that defines business rules and constraints for the S1000D Free Open Source Software Interest Group. Created February 14, 2019, and classified as unverified, it establishes standardized rules applicable to all documentation within this organization's technical publications framework. The document serves as a governance reference for technical data module creation and compliance.

This S1000D document is an introductory chapter table of contents for FOSSIG technical documentation. It provides a structured index listing chapter numbers, titles, and corresponding data module codes for navigating related technical manuals and specifications. Published January 9, 2019, it serves as an organizational reference point for the complete FOSSIG documentation set.

This S1000D technical document is an introductory chapter explaining the Free Open Source Software Interest Group (FOSSIG) initiative. It outlines FOSSIG's purpose—applying S1000D documentation standards to free software and developing supporting open-source tools—and its scope, including developing common business rules and a generic Standard Numbering System for free software projects. The document provides references for further information on S1000D and FOSSIG.

This S1000D document is a technical manual chapter (3.1) describing the FOSSIG Standard Numbering System (SNS). Published February 13, 2019, by khzae.net, it serves as placeholder documentation indicating that the SNS specification will be included in a future issue. The document is currently unverified and applies to all configurations.

This S1000D data management list (DML) is a catalog index issued January 9, 2019 by the FOSSIG (Free Open Source Software Interest Group) that lists and organizes references to documentation modules and publications. It contains entries for front matter (title page, abbreviations, table of contents), business rules, three main chapters covering FOSSIG introduction/business rules/standard numbering system, and a publication manual reference—each with assigned document codes, titles, and responsible parties.
